request: Option to skip the intro and reach the title screen quickly (for faster testing)
implementation: runtime/src/hle/storage/dvd.cpp: partition reads of /Video/FrontEnd/Mp3_Title_Sequence.thp or /Video/FrontEnd/attract01.thp stamp a timestamp; PrimeIntroVideoState() reports before-video / video (read within 750 ms) / video-ended.

runtime/src/hle/input/kpad.cpp: SkipIntroButtons() ORs WPAD A (0x0800) into the KPAD sample every other 8 retraces (counter 0x8067E754) during the wrist-strap screen (before any video, capped at 90 s) and while an intro/attract THP streams. Applied to both the keyboard/mouse path and the real Wii Remote path. The game ends each screen itself; no game code or state is patched.

Enable with: WiiCompiled.exe --skip-intro (the only accepted argument), [prime] skip_intro = true in Config.toml, the F1 > Diagnostico checkbox 'Saltar la intro al iniciar' (takes effect on restart), or WII_COMPILED_PRIME_SKIP_INTRO=1.

validation.baseline_without_option: video still playing at 35 s, title screen at 45 s
validation.with_option: title screen 'PRESS A TO START' at 15 s; log [prime-skip-intro] before-video t=0, video t=3.5 s, video-ended t=6.4 s (seconds since first KPAD read)

not_done: Loading a specific save directly (quick-load) was not implemented; the option stops at the title screen.
